name: @jarvis/relay
description: Remote MCP relay for Jarvis Desktop (Cloudflare Worker + Durable Object, free tier) so ChatGPT can reach Jarvis on your computer.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores OAuth clients, grants and tokens issued to ChatGPT. Created automatically.

DESKTOP_LINK.description: One Durable Object per paired computer; holds the desktop's WebSocket. Created automatically.

PAIR_REGISTRY.description: Stores pairing records (pair id, secret hash, label). Created automatically.
